title: Attack on Zuwarah
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Attack on Zuwarah", at revision 1370429622, opens: "The Attack on Zuwarah was a military expedition launched by Knights Hospitallers of Malta to sack the Libyan city of Zuwarah. The attack ended in a fiasco for the Maltese knights, who sustained heavy losses." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q133837258, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1552 military expedition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
